concept: A compact pair of archer gloves with three parallel reinforced finger guides converging at one narrow wrist brace. Supple dark leather, pale bone finger splints and restrained green stitched seams. Three fingers held close express narrowed multishot.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: LA02, Narrowed Line, class Ranger, slot gloves or gauntlets.
Subject design: A compact pair of archer gloves with three parallel reinforced finger guides converging at one narrow wrist brace. Supple dark leather, pale bone finger splints and restrained green stitched seams. Three fingers held close express narrowed multishot.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: Multishot narrows to 20 degrees, landing up to 3 arrows on the same enemy.
Direct skill context: A02 Multishot — Fires 3 arrows in a 60 degree arc.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels, square PNG with native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. The entire subject, including all tips and chain, must fit inside the central 76%: x 123 to 901, y 123 to 901. Leave at least 123 truly empty pixels on every side. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
